text:
Jimmy Snuggerud marked his 100th NHL game with a power-play goal against New Jersey on Saturday, then scored again the next night against Edmonton. That's goals in three straight games and 14 in 24, and it has made him the engine of a winning week in St. Louis. Our wins-added measure, which credits goals by how much they swung the game, ranks him 13th among 559 skaters.

The finishing is running hot: 26% shooting against 12% last season, on 7.0 expected goals (the quality of his chances), and the Blues have scored 8.9 more goals than expected with him on. That rate rarely lasts. What does last is where he shoots from. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him in the 96th percentile for chances from the slot last season, and 29% of his setups came from behind the net, against 8% for a typical forward. St. Louis is also winning the chance battle with him on, with 54% of the expected goals at five on five. Our numbers project about 36 goals. Watch the defensive side, where Evolving-Hockey found opponents got more chances with him on the ice last season.
headline: Jimmy Snuggerud's hot hands, and where they come from
